frame_metadata.gps_note: Every frame carries capture time with a -04:00 offset and the F0 build's 9-key GPS block. But from the first label (f0004, 16:18) to the exterior (f0028, 16:33) every frame carries the same fix, taken at 16:16:20 by the entrance: the phone produced no new fix indoors. The fix places the take at Cooper Hewitt; it says nothing about where in the building a frame was shot.

traps.year_twice: The dress is dated 1966 and was acquired in 1966, so the title date and the key's first group are the same number on one card. A reader that takes the key's year as the object's date is right here by accident.
